origin.description: Stores month names, weekday names, and the AM/PM marks. Weekdays start on Sunday.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The data, path, or collector this function accepts.

origin.details: Stores month names, weekday names, and the AM/PM marks. Weekdays start on Sunday.
origin.value: The same value readr 2.2.0 returns for this case, written as one line in the output.
origin.example:
names <- date_names(month.name, month.abb, c("Sunday", "Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday"), c("Sun", "Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat"))
paste(names$mon[1], names$mon_ab[1], names$day[1], names$day_ab[1], sep = ";")

translation.description: Stores month names, weekday names, and the AM/PM marks. Weekdays start on Sunday.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The data, path, or collector this function accepts.

translation.details: Stores month names, weekday names, and the AM/PM marks. Weekdays start on Sunday.
translation.value: The same value readr 2.2.0 returns for this case, written as one line in the output.
translation.example:
months = ["January", "February", "March", "April", "May", "June", "July", "August", "September", "October", "November", "December"]
short = ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"]
days = ["Sunday", "Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday"]
day_ab = ["Sun", "Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat"]
names = date_names(months, short, days, day_ab)
return names.mon[0] + ";" + names.mon_ab[0] + ";" + names.day[0] + ";" + names.day_ab[0]
